reasons.plausibility: Introducing small amounts of boron to improve grain-boundary cohesion while minimally affecting the bulk phase transformation is scientifically well-grounded and aligns with known alloy strengthening methods.
reasons.testability: The proposed side-by-side testing of boron-doped and undoped alloys under identical conditions with direct property measurements offers a clear pathway to confirm or refute the hypothesis.
reasons.usefulness: Strengthening a magnetocaloric material without sacrificing caloric response is a critical goal, making this approach both well-targeted and practically valuable.
